description: This header file declares interfaces and classes for a Data Model (dm) client component, including the dmClient class, dmClientNotifier interface, and related proxy class. It defines methods for executing queries, notification callbacks, and creation/destruction of dmClient instances.

classes.name: dmProviderProxy
classes.description: A placeholder class for the data model provider proxy, currently with no members or methods.

classes.name: dmClientNotifier
classes.description: An interface for receiving callbacks from dmClient operations, including success and error notifications.

classes.name: dmClient
classes.description: An interface defining a data model client responsible for executing queries and managing its lifecycle.

methods.name: dmClient::runQuery
methods.description: Executes a data model query with given parameters, supports recursion, and notifies via dmClientNotifier.

methods.name: dmClient::create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a dmClient object given a datamodel directory and log level.

methods.name: dmClient::destroy
methods.description: Static method to destroy and clean up a dmClient instance.
